d: During the ongoing Pakistan tri-nation ODI series, Mike Hesson has thrown his weight behind former Pakistan captain Babar Azam and Fakhar Zaman, calling them two of the greatest players in Pakistan cricket history. But with the two senior batters struggling for runs, questions are being asked. As Pakistan cricket continues to deal with inconsistent performances, selection debates and pressure on the coaching staff by the PCB, Rupha Ramani examines Hesson's backing of Babar and Fakhar and what it tells us about the Pakistan’s present situation.
